distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Polygraphus szemaoensis from Kangding, Sichuan, and Lijiang and Simao, Yunnan. Huang et al. (2015) also listed Sichuan and Yunnan. These are literature-based occurrence records; the checklist occurrence review has not yet been completed. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Guizhou as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) reported all four conifer host taxa; Huang et al. (2015) repeated the same four taxa. Names are retained as published, including Pinus khasya; the host associations have not yet received an independent review.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Polygraphus szemaoensis Tsai & Yin, 1965.
